name: egoe-public-site
description: Reproducible public build and quality gates for the EGOE static site

scripts.build: node tools/sync-site-shell.mjs --check && node tools/sync-product-data.mjs --check && node tools/build-public-site.mjs
scripts.check:data: npm run test:data && node tools/sync-product-data.mjs --check && node tools/verify-product-data.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:shell && npm run check:data && npm run build && npm run check:artifact && npm run check:seo
